text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Now... I wonder if you can keep up with me!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
...Nghh!!
I won't let you... go alone!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've got my pride too, you know!
I'm gonna catch you...! Hmphhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If it comes down to pride...
I will not lose!!!! Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAAAH!!
GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Verxina, every Umamusume in the race dashes through with fierce determination...
As the crowd roars with excitement at the thrilling spectacle—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The winner is Verxina!!
With her proud fighting spirit!
She has claimed a massive, massive victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This victory is truly, truly monumental. For it is proof that Verxina overcame her trials and blossomed right where she aimed to be...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And once again, I felt it. Truly,
her fighting spirit to 'win for her younger sisters'
is a weapon superior to anything else—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...!
So awesome...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's so crazy good!
And wow, Verxina really is strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Verxina!!
You are the new Mile Queen--!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that is correct.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The queen is none other than myself,
and—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I shall claim the Queen Elizabeth II Cup as well, and display my sheer perfection for all to see!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis / Big brother,
congratulatiooooons♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you came!
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Is Cheval
not with you today?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So basically,
she's debuting next year,
so she wants to train!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I can't wait~! Cheval-chi's definitely gonna do amazing, just like her big sis!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For now, I sent a quick bulletin with the results♪
I bet they're super happy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Big Sis,
you were seriously so cool~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I'm truly so glad.♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I never properly told you, did I?
I'm sorry for startling you back then."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It just made me realize
how cool my big sister is, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You face tough challenges head-on,
and then you pull off a win just like today, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...
You're the absolute best big sister♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~ Maybe I should aim for the Tiara route too♡
It just looks so sparkly~.
choice_data_list: So you're not scheduled to debut yet, huh.
You aren't scheduled to debut yet, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup, not a single one!
Right now I'm checking out all kinds of things to learn♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Then make sure you watch
the Queen Elizabeth II Cup closely too."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show you an even cooler side
of your big sis than today."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Yay, I can't wait♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna tell all my friends too♪
I'll say, 'My big sis is super cool, so make sure to watch!'

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For now...
this is fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Intrigued by her suggestive wording, I decided to ask her about it once we finished all our preparations--

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please look at Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Innocent and pure, just like an angel, isn't she?
Right now, it seems like she just finds every single day fun and full of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
For now, that's fine.
However...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Someday, she too will throw herself into grueling races.
She will surely come to know hardship—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If you have something to support you then,
you can stand back up as many times as it takes, right?
choice_data_list: So that was... your motive for aiming for the top.
So that was... your motive for aiming for the top.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
To become a guiding light for my younger sisters...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...After everything that happened with Ms. Gentil, I found myself losing my way, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Today's victory made me certain.
—There is still only one thing I must do."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shining with the queen's brilliance,
I will show my younger sisters... the path they must follow!
choice_data_list: ...Let's win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup too!
...Let's win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, my photos aren't turning out cute at aaaaall!
Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah.
Give me a second!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of her little sister, toward another throne.
Her next goal, beyond the scorching summer,
is the Queen Elizabeth II Cup."
